interpretationRule: A prior-cycle notice may document workflow shape, but it cannot populate exact dates, documents, medical rules or submission instructions for the 2026 first-phase cohort unless a current-cohort official notice explicitly supports them.

recruitmentRegistration.note: 2026 first-phase application notice verified; application window 2026-07-27 through 2026-08-02 is closed.

epsTopikSchedule.note: The first-phase notice establishes EPS-TOPIK and test format, but KEP has not verified a later current-cohort individual exam schedule/result notice from the official notice index as of 2026-10-05.

epsTopikResult.note: No 2026 first-phase result notice has been promoted into KEP exact rules as of this check.

priorCycleEvidence.note: 2025 Manufacturing/Agriculture first-round passers received a Skill & Competency schedule for April 19–28, 2026. Those dates are not reused for the 2026 first-phase cohort.
2025 Manufacturing second-round Skill & Competency result notice, published May 11, 2026.
June 25, 2026 employment-application notice explicitly belongs to the 2025 Manufacturing cohort.

postSelectionVisaDeparture.note: Departure notices exist for workers already in later pipeline stages, but KEP has not scoped them as exact rules for the 2026 first-phase recruitment cohort.

blockers: current-cohort EPS-TOPIK schedule/result not yet promoted from an official notice
current-cohort Skill & Competency notice not yet verified
current-cohort medical/job-application rules not yet verified
current-cohort downstream visa/training/departure exact rules not yet scoped

promoteOnlyWhen: an official notice explicitly identifies the 2026 first-phase cohort or an unambiguous 2026 current cohort
the notice content, not only its title, is reviewed when exact dates/documents/rules are added
prior-cycle 2025 wording is not reused as a current-cycle exact rule
